name: independent-c53-linked-work

steps.action: C53 guide section: Matters appear on the Entity through their saved Entity-valued Field
steps.actual: The Entity's Matters tab rolled up M-29 "Rev C53b open matter RZ4A78" and showed no row for the Confidential M-30 this reader cannot reach

steps.action: C53 guide section: opening a rolled-up Matter reaches that Matter's own record
steps.actual: Selecting the rolled-up Matter opened 29 showing "Rev C53b open matter RZ4A78"

steps.action: C53 guide section: the Entity tab counts report only what this reader reaches
steps.actual: On the Entity record the Contracts tab badge read "1 linked Contract" (1) and the Matters tab badge read "1 linked Matter" (1); the counts endpoint corroborated {"contracts":1,"matters":1}

steps.action: C53 guide section: linked Contracts show only the rows this reader reaches
steps.actual: The Entity's Contracts tab listed C-49 only; the Confidential C-50 contributed no row for this reader

steps.action: C53 guide section: Matters appear on the Entity through their saved Entity-valued Field
steps.actual: The Entity's Matters tab rolled up both M-29 "Rev C53b open matter RZ4A78" and the Confidential M-30 for the Administrator who reaches both

steps.action: C53 guide section: opening a rolled-up Matter reaches that Matter's own record
steps.actual: Selecting the rolled-up Matter opened 29 showing "Rev C53b open matter RZ4A78"

steps.action: C53 guide section: the Entity tab counts report only what this reader reaches
steps.actual: On the Entity record the Contracts tab badge read "2 linked Contracts" (2) and the Matters tab badge read "2 linked Matters" (2); the counts endpoint corroborated {"contracts":2,"matters":2}

steps.action: C53 guide section: linked Contracts show only the rows this reader reaches
steps.actual: The Entity's Contracts tab listed both C-49 and the Confidential C-50, which the Administrator reaches

steps.action: C53 negative: Administrator and Legal counts differ by exactly the inaccessible records
steps.actual: Against the same Entity the Administrator's badges read "2 linked Contracts" and "2 linked Matters" while the Legal Team Member's read "1 linked Contract" and "1 linked Matter" — each short by exactly the one Confidential record that reader cannot reach

steps.action: C53 guide section: a saved Entity value keeps the roll-up after its Field is detached
steps.actual: After an Administrator fixture detached "Rev C53b signing entity RZ4A78" from the Employment Matter type, the Entity's Matters tab still listed M-29 and its badge still read "2 linked Matters", so the saved value kept the link

steps.action: C53 guide section: the detached Field's saved link still reads for a Legal Team Member
steps.actual: With the Field detached the Legal Team Member still saw M-29 under the Entity with a badge of "1 linked Matter", still saw no Confidential row, and opened the Matter at http://127.0.0.1:43306/matters/29
